title: Question with a false premise
decision: whether a question rests on a false premise, judged from the question alone at the date of the snapshot

source.name: FreshQA: Vu et al., FreshLLMs: Refreshing Large Language Models with Search Engine Augmentation (2023), arXiv:2310.03214
source.split: TEST (500 of 600 questions; the other 100 are DEV)
source.version: sheet "FreshQA April 21, 2026" (file name FreshQA_v042126-freshqa.csv), linked from the README at commit 7d2d3683991916f3633e480548a6aa5c9a62e3db (2026-05-01); exported 2026-10-07

licence: repository "Apache License 2.0" (file LICENSE); the question sheet is a Google Sheet linked from the README and carries no licence statement of its own
notes: Classes as they are: 124 yes (false_premise TRUE) + 376 no (FALSE); no sampling. The flag describes the world at the date of the snapshot, so the question sentence names that date; the authors revise questions, flags and answers, and other snapshots differ (false-premise questions by fact_type in this one: fast-changing 2, never-changing 63, slow-changing 59; meta keeps fact_type, num_hops, effective_year). Redistribution is set to the rebuild script because the Apache licence is stated for the repository and the questions are not in the repository. The file opens with a notice of the authors: "Warning: Please do not click thumbs up/down when trying these examples on any model's web interface, as the data will be used for training future versions of those models." Text unchanged except leading/trailing whitespace (6 rows). Decontamination against the authors' training data (scan of 7 October 2026, 1,546,178 training records): 2 of 500 items removed because a text field of the item occurs in it; 498 items remain.
